transcript.text: I was looking back at my 2025 trip notes—Xi'an was such a highlight, I remember just wandering around and talking about the attractions with everyone.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier that same March, I kept telling people how the Beijing-to-Shanghai leg felt like the backbone of the whole trip.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Beijing itself was kind of a blur, but I do remember we were chatting about hotels there a lot, since everyone had different budgets.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the Xi'an day, my friend Li Na was the one who handled the Terracotta Warriors tickets—she set it for 2025-03-22, if I’m reading this right.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: She even picked the afternoon time slot, and somehow we ended up being a group of 5—honestly I would’ve messed that up myself.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Beijing we stayed at the Beijing Hotel—check-in was 2025-03-22 for 2 nights, and it was booked under Zhou Jun’s name, not mine.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and the train ticket was already sorted too: D321 on 2025-03-20, passenger name Zhang Wei, Second Class—pretty sure that’s what the screenshot says.
